intent: Divide the groups of a form with a horizontal rule, optionally carrying a short caption in its middle.
typical_uses: A divider between two ways of completing a form, captioned "or continue with"

dont_use_when.situation: A divider outside a Field composition, or one with no caption

invariants.text: FieldSeparator renders a div holding the kit Separator, which keeps its role="separator", drawn across the middle; its children, when given, sit centered over the rule in a span painted with the --background color so the rule appears to stop around them. With no children only the rule renders.
It is --space-5 tall with a negative --space-2 margin above and below, so it sits closer to its neighbours than the group's own gap.

anti_patterns.dont: Place a captioned FieldSeparator on a surface other than the page background
anti_patterns.do_instead: Keep it on the page background; the caption span always paints --background and takes no className of its own, so on any other surface it shows as a box

a11y.by: field.test.tsx asserts that the rendered FieldSeparator contains an element with role="separator"

children.states: children is the caption shown in the middle of the rule, any React content
children.because: `ReactNode` is a union of elements, strings, numbers, fragments and more; the compiler emits one JSON type per property. Omitted, null, false or an empty string render no caption span.

unexposed_parts.part: The kit Separator and the caption span
unexposed_parts.reason: FieldSeparator composes the kit's own Separator and a fixed caption span into one exported component; neither takes props from the consumer, and the className and other forwarded attributes land on the outer div.

good.title: A captioned divider between two groups

bad.title: Separator props passed to FieldSeparator
bad.why: FieldSeparator is a div around a fixed horizontal Separator; it has no orientation prop and does not pass one to the Separator. Use Separator for a vertical divider.
